newsitem.title: USA: Maryland Gov names Frece to head 'smart growth'.
newsitem.headline: Maryland Gov names Frece to head 'smart growth'.

text.p: Maryland Gov. Parris Glendening named his press chief, John Frece, to oversee the state's new "smart growth" development program.

The smart growth legislation, which was passed by the legislature last session, permits the governor to funnel state construction funds to revitalize areas that are already developed, and to discourage growth in areas that are considered "green."
Frece, a former Baltimore Sun reporter, said he has been an advocate of the idea since it was first proposed.
